## Requirements: WebSocket Runtime V2 — bounded ingress, Control and Request execution

### Scope and independent delivery
Parent #4431; main baseline e656d1f9c95baafc8735a2bb0274f668a2cc30d7. No historical Issue is reopened, reused or required for execution. Own shared inbound dispatcher, admission, task supervision and Request execution in nession-runtime and the read-side adapters of Server, Agent P2P, Agent central and Relay. No hard dependency on other V2 issues. Use current outbound API/stream provider interfaces until replacement; do not edit writer scheduling or terminal delivery semantics. Historical #961/#1021/#974 are reference/regression constraints only, not reopened/reused.
Baseline findings: lane.rs QueryLane::dispatch and KeyedLane::enqueue retain completed JoinSet entries without steady-state reaping; read loops await lane permits, key queues and Ordered drain; runtime mutation lane has no fixed global budget; Inline contains business writes. Central and P2P share resource scheduler.
Design:
- Continuously reap finished tasks, record panic/cancel outcomes and ensure keyed worker failure releases its key/queued permits; no unbounded detached task. Bounded task bookkeeping including completed records; race-safe cancellation and shutdown.
- Atomically admit or refuse ordinary requests without waiting for business permits in Reader; count and byte limits include queued, running and pre-admission work. Explicit overload outcome, use existing compatible error envelope or version policy, reserve reply path via adapter; if refusal cannot be delivered close explicitly. Runtime/connection/key/operation budgets, fair share and no nested indefinite permit waits. Defaults measured/configurable; no fixed thread pool.
- Classify authenticated control, RPC completion and mode transitions separately from Request; correlation checks identity/id/generation before dispatch. Transition owner can wait off reader while fencing dependent operations; auth never bypassed, close always settles. Control work bounded; no slow database/tmux work inline. Preserve same-resource FIFO across P2P and central, canonical keys and existing protocol versions.
- Audit every core and extension execution declaration incl. MCP calls, agent/project/commands writes; expensive synchronous operations have separate budget, existing domain jobs stay owned by domain. Missing unsafe policy fails closed, no wire prefix-based classification or second manifest. Stream handoff exposed through current provider adapter; no stream migration in this issue.
- Public seam: nonblocking admit(validated envelope, provider policy, connection generation), returns accepted/refused/closed; execution emits classified completion via outbound interface. Common metrics hooks for used/limit, queue wait, reaped/active, admission outcome. No external exporter required.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 A deterministic CI stress test submits 100,000 short queries and changing keys with small configured budgets; live and retained task records stay within explicit documented bounds, all completed records/permits/keys settle after quiescence, including injected panic/cancellation.
- [ ] SC-02 At the exact-head Rust Quality Gate (`rust-check` → `rust-test-unit`), the bounded-dispatch test `the_central_connection_refuses_past_its_bound_and_drains` executes and passes: a brokered command refused past the connection bound is answered on `server.agent.command-response` carrying its `request_id`, so the Server settles the pending waiter instead of letting it time out. Together with the exact-head barrier tests saturating per-connection and process-wide count/byte budgets across multiple connections, this proves excess work is explicitly refused before acceptance, ordinary reader admission never waits for business work, and independent resource operations complete without starvation.
- [x] SC-03 A source-aligned isolated staging protocol Case on all three WS ingress roles proves heartbeat/response resolution remains live under blocked request saturation, auth/relay transition fences dependent work, and same-session mutations across central/P2P retain FIFO; no stale identity accepts work.
- [x] SC-04 Exact-source policy coverage and negative fixtures prove each served core/extension wire declares a compatible provider policy or is refused; long-running calls cannot exhaust fast-query budget and slow business writes are not Reader-inline.

SC → scenario: SC-01 SCN-06 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result); SC-02 SCN-06 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result); SC-03 SCN-03 (isolated source-aligned staging Case; trusted run/attempt/SHA evidence); SC-04 SCN-01 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result). For runtime Cases use approved full-stack-local protocol/runtime verifier with private tmux and bounded fault injection; for Knowledge publication use existing trusted publisher/readback receipt, never grant PR credentials. No blanket Full E2E or production probe.
